characters.name: tomb-robber-criminal-mastermind
characters.role: one character across two career-stage costumes — rises from a small-time tomb robber to the infamous Criminal Mastermind. Not the generic NPC sprites of the same names (those are tagged growtopia/npc/pixel-sprite, a different format's untagged style) — this is a fresh character-story-bound anchor with its own two-stage appearance card.

costume_stages.tomb-robber (early stage): blocky humanoid Growtopian build with a large square head, tan/beige blocky skin, two white dot eyes with black pupils peering out above a dusty cloth bandana pulled up over the lower face, thick clean black outline running along every edge of the body, a frayed brown leather chest wrap over a tattered off-white undershirt, a weathered canvas satchel slung diagonally across one shoulder, tan cargo-wrapped pants, a small rusted crowbar holstered at the hip, tiny blocky hands smudged with dust, no cape or coat, scruffy unpolished silhouette
costume_stages.criminal-mastermind (later stage): same blocky humanoid Growtopian build and large square head, tan/beige blocky skin, two sharp white dot eyes with black pupils now half-hidden behind a thin black domino eye-mask, thick clean black outline running along every edge of the body, a long tailored dark-purple coat with a high collar over a crisp black shirt, polished black trousers, a slim silver-topped cane held in one gloved blocky hand, a small glint of gold cufflinks at the wrist, upright confident posture, no bandana, no satchel

narrator.register: young teen boy (~13), NOT an adult man; light youthful timbre, warm, reflective first-person. Casual_Guy/Young_Knight/Deep_Voice_Man read too adult for a child narrator (burned 2026-07-17).
narrator.note: No approved Chatterbox sample owned by this bible. The default skin is the nameless everyplayer, so voice identity is not critical — MiniMax narration is acceptable per user authorization.
